title: Go / hold / no-go decision gate
description: Applies pre-declared decision criteria and follows a contingency branch for hold outcomes.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: go-hold-no-go
  title: Go / hold / no-go decision gate
  description: Applies pre-declared decision criteria and follows a contingency branch for hold outcomes.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Make stage-gate decisions against transparent thresholds.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - gate-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Gate evidence and criteria
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - proposal
          - criteria
          - evidence
          - contingencies
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: assess
      kind: agent
      name: Assess gate criteria
      role: Gate reviewer
      prompt: Evaluate each pre-declared criterion as met, unmet, or uncertain using only provided evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Determine gate outcome
      role: Decision gate evaluator
      prompt: Return passed for go, failed for hold or no-go, and include outcome classification.
      config:
        threshold: 1
    - id: contingency
      kind: agent
      name: Create hold contingency plan
      role: Program manager
      prompt: For hold outcomes, define missing evidence, owners, deadlines, and re-entry criteria. For no-go, define closure
        actions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: gate-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Gate owner confirms outcome
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Go / hold / no-go record and contingency plan
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: assess
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: assess
      to: gate
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: gate
      to: gate-owner
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e4
      from: gate
      to: contingency
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e5
      from: contingency
      to: gate-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e6
      from: gate-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
